kbx_bulk.b:
Kolaboro / Registers

Bulk register check

For agencies and lenders: check up to 200 properties, permits or companies at once against the official registers we query live, and download the results as CSV. Register lookups only, fixed rules, each result sealed with a hash.

1. Your list

One item per line, or a CSV file with one item per row. A last column holding a two-letter country code (ES, US, GB) is used as the country; other columns are read as part of the item, so keep one item per row. A header row is skipped. Accepted: Spanish cadastral references (14 or 20 characters), NYC street addresses with the borough, NYC DOB or DOB NOW job numbers, Miami-Dade permit numbers, UK company numbers, company names (searched in GLEIF). Website links are not checked in bulk. Have project names, developer names or website links instead? Use the bulk check against our index.

2. Limits

Without a key: 20 lookups an hour per visitor, the same limit as the single lookup (an item checked in the last 10 minutes comes from cache and does not count). The check pauses when the limit is reached and you can resume later. With a partner API key every row is metered on your key instead. Ask for a key. The key stays in this page and is sent only to kolaboro.com.

3. Results

#ItemRecognised asRegister resultsSealed result

Each result is what the named official register returned at that moment, kept byte for byte and sealed. Not found or not published is not proof of a problem; found is not proof a project is sound. For one project with its website, use the free check.

API

Same thing without the page: POST up to 5 rows per call.
